measurement: line-count ratchet: a measured runtime file may never exceed its recorded value; `ceiling` is the absolute bound that only an explicitly recorded decision may raise
history: v53.96/P895 (commit 6fd5289b, 2026-08-10) introduced fixed caps on three files. Those caps were never read from this file — the numbers were hardcoded in scripts/ci-decomp-hotspot-check.mjs, so the declaration and the enforcement could silently disagree. They also covered only 3 of 7 runtime files, so accretion escaped sideways into aio-ui/aio-chat/aio-tests, and at js/aio-core.js the cap sat 1 line above the file — a wall that blocked a one-line correctness fix instead of a ratchet. v56.61/P1291–P1298 records deliberate ratchet growth of js/aio-core.js (+3) and js/aio-data.js (+5) for strict millisecond-precision live-core freshness and future timestamp rejection, and js/aio-pages.js (+38) for escaped Risk Radar source labels and canonical official HTTPS links. These additions remove stale-input waivers and unsafe source rendering; include this rationale in the eventual release commit. v57.31/P1591 records js/aio-ui.js +5 for the legacy diagram engine and external-metric card: theme-token palette (light theme drew white on ivory), AI switch unavailable state, and one collapsed line for unreceived metrics instead of N/A cards — a correctness fix inside a not-yet-migrated legacy renderer. v57.31/P1592 records js/aio-data.js +10 (officer-title/agency acronym gate on local and translation-cache news tickers, template news summary removed), js/aio-workspace.js +2 (KR suffix normalization, field-specific errors, edit vs duplicate) and index.html +1 (Korea reference chip style): all are correctness fixes inside legacy owners that still render these surfaces. v57.31/P1593 records js/aio-glossary.js +1: the dated Fed balance-sheet figure carries its declared source row (QA-GLOSSARY-SWEEP requires one per figure). v57.32/P1599 records index.html growth for the visual pass stylesheet (home index-vs-participation pair, briefing move bars, 13F quarter trend, capex lead-time rows, weight bars, chart captions) and js/aio-data.js +1 for neutral, named freshness dots: presentation rules that live with the static shell's stylesheet and the legacy freshness writer. v57.32/P1600 records js/aio-data.js +13 for machine-translation phrase repairs (F27: kept who-affects-whom and finance idioms in the free translation path that the legacy news writer owns) and tightens js/aio-ui.js by 313 lines (unreferenced legacy page-help registry removed). v57.39/P1621–P1623 keeps js/aio-chat.js +2 for the question-context compatibility facade after moving its selection implementation to src/ai/context/market-content.js; index.html glossary search styles move to native CSS and aio-core shrinks by one line. js/aio-pages.js +4 preserves distinct business-automation, medical-robot and humanoid classifications instead of merging unrelated companies to satisfy a sample floor. Classification accepts small groups while the strength model still requires three observed members. Record this bounded legacy registry/facade rationale in the eventual release commit. v57.54/P1756 records index.html +79 (7935 -> 8014) for the on-demand chart loader: a deferred Chart constructor that requests Chart.js on first use, builds pending charts on the same canvas/config and replays early defaults, plus the lightweight-charts loader; it replaces eager boot tags and preloads (Chart.js, lightweight-charts) that no first screen used. aio-chat.js (retries without web search) stays net-negative; aio-data.js -62, aio-pages.js -29 and aio-tests.js -1 in the same change. v57.60 records js/aio-qa-audits.js +453 (4223 -> 4676): the QA-only AIO_PAGE_SEQUENTIAL_AUDIT_REGISTRY (v49.37~v49.62 authored page audit log) moved out of the user-parsed js/aio-core.js into the on-demand QA bundle with a merge shim over the boot-time contract-derived registry; the same change removes dead legacy writers (breadth DOM cluster, VIX/news/FRED/conclusion-bar sinks), so the runtime files shrink by far more (aio-core -625, aio-ui -235, aio-data -179, aio-pages -56, index.html -39).

ceilingHistory.reason: The /relay client path, the three restored web-search credential inputs, the Claude server-key-mode toggle and the observed-vs-stored provider status added 54 lines. The previous 28000 sat one line above the file — the exact wall P1127 replaced with a ratchet — so the recorded decision is a raise with real headroom, not another near-boundary.

The legacy news sample guard adds 15 lines to reject sub-N signals and malformed synthetic scores at market-state, narrative, action-plan and loop-audit boundaries. Keeping the guard in the established compatibility path is required for F-52 closure; the previous 28200 ceiling was crossed by 7 lines, so this explicit 50-line window preserves readable regression coverage with 43 lines of headroom. The release commit remains pending strict data-refresh and approval boundaries.

The cumulative handoff fixes grew aio-core from 28210 to 28251 (+41), crossing the recorded absolute ceiling by one line. The growth carries executable safeguards for source-grounded macro events and calendars, strict millisecond freshness/future rejection, decision-grade news sample boundaries, and fail-closed cycle evidence. Keep a 50-line window so those contracts remain readable and the ratchet still catches further growth; do not raise this ceiling again without first evaluating extraction. Record this rationale in the eventual release commit after D0 data/lineage acceptance.
